p.s: 12 June 2001
Dear Mrs Smith
Thank you for your letter dated 8 June 2001.
I hope I can give you the information you need.
So the conference will be a great experience to you and your group.
Your group will stay at the Palace Hotel.
The Palace Hotel is situated in the town centre next to the railway station.
A free shuttel-bus gets you to the conference-center.
The bus leavs at 8 a.m. at the front entrance of the hotel.
The end-of-conference party is playing in a rent and in the greenground.
There will be a barbecue, a place to dance and many more.
It is a surprice!
I suggest to wear leisure-clothes to the party.
The last afternoon you could go on a city-tour, visite the museum of Fine Arts or enjoy the beautiful flower garden next to the common park.
I hope I could give you some ideas.
I look forward to seeing you.
Yours sincerely,

coded_answer.p: What would life be without the phone?

Have you ever thought about a world without
phone?
How was it
in the
18
century with no
opportunity
to communicate
by phone
and
how would it be
now?

I
can not
imagine how our life would be. We
are living
in a busy world. In the business world you use the phone all the time to speak with your clients, to make appointments, to order an article
e.c.
;
then
, time is money!

How has the phone affected my own life? I think
,
that is a good question to think about. I could not call my friends from
an other
city and just say "hello". It would be difficult and
take
more time to make an appointment.

So, what
did the
phone-revolution
for us? It saves
time.

p.s: What would life be without the phone?
Have you ever thought about a world without phone?
How was it in the 18 century with no opportunity to communicate by phone and how would it be now?
I can not imagine how our life would be.
We are living in a busy world.
In the business world you use the phone all the time to speak with your clients, to make appointments, to order an article e.c.; then, time is money!
How has the phone affected my own life?
I think, that is a good question to think about.
I could not call my friends from an other city and just say "hello".
It would be difficult and take more time to make an appointment.
So, what did the phone-revolution for us?
It saves time.
